strategies.name: vwap_break_and_pullback_long
strategies.entry_summary: Only on high-volume, lower-float penny stocks, wait for a stock that opened weak below VWAP to break back above VWAP with strong volume and obvious bullish momentum. Enter long on the subsequent pullback/retest of VWAP or a nearby key level as support, looking for the bounce.
strategies.exit_summary: Manage as a scalp by selling into the bounce after VWAP holds and price pushes back up; the transcript does not give a precise stop/target formula, but the taught management is to use VWAP as the support thesis and avoid long entries when VWAP remains overhead as resistance.

variants.variant_label: VWAP pullback long after break with volume
variants.timeframe_note: Intraday, typically after the opening bell once volume expands
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Wait for strong volume, multiple green candles, a break above VWAP, then a clear pullback into VWAP support before going
variants.target_note: Scalp the bounce upward after support holds
variants.transcript_quote: when the stock actually breaks above the v-wop after being below it at the opening bell i'm looking to buy on those pull backs looking for the v-wap [

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches one long-only VWAP-reclaim pullback setup repeatedly across examples; bearish rejection below VWAP is discussed as context/filter, not promoted to a separate runnable strategy with its own concrete exit.
